title: Plant-Based 'Chicken' and Cashew Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Pak Choy and Egg Noodles
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Quarter the pak choy lengthwise. Thickly slice the onion. Quarter the zucchini lengthwise, then thinly slice. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Coarsely chop the cashews. Combine 1½ tbs soy sauce, 1 tbs barbecue sauce and 2 tsp honey in a bowl.
Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Start stir-fry: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat (see Kitchen 101). Stir-fry the onion, chicken-style strips and garlic for 2-3 mins until the onion is softened. Add the zucchini and pak choy and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until the vegetables are tender but still have crunch.

Finish stir-fry: Add the soy sauce mixture and three-quarters of the cashews to the veggie mixture and stir-fry for a further 2-3 mins until the sauce is slightly thickened. Add the noodles and stir-fry for 30 secs or until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the plant-based 'chicken' stir-fry among bowls, scatter over the remaining cashews and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Fast and hot is key when stir-frying! Make sure you cook over high heat, stirring constantly so everything is cooked evenly. We've used a deep frypan, but you can use a wok if you have one.
